verdict.rationale: Viam's Registry supplies hardware drivers. You name the hardware model in the config, and viam-server pulls the driver from the Registry and initializes it automatically. Models can be searched by manufacturer or hardware type (e.g. viam:raspberry-pi:rpi5, viam:ufactory:xArm6), and the pricing page advertises 'Pre-built modules or build your own.' Logic modules for behaviors are documented, though only as things you build. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that reusable behavior/logic modules (not just hardware drivers) can be pulled from the Registry, details on Registry breadth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pull workflow.
